exposure: diagnosis of fetal loss of wellbeing
Two groups of physicians: Group A (first quartile of cesarean section rate) and Group B (fourth quartile of cesarean section rate)
outcome: length of first stage of delivery
length of second stage of delivery
cohort: Nulliparous women at term in spontaneous labor
finding: Cesarean section rates in nulliparous women were significantly influenced by individual physician's decisions, potentially due to over-diagnosis of dystocia and fetal compromise.
